classifications.rationale: The President recounts directing the National Security Council to investigate federal employee-security program administration; the consequence is an internal study and report, not a change in employment rights or status.
classifications.evidence: I requested the National Security Council to make an investigation of the administration of Federal employee security programs

classifications.rationale: The President asks the Civil Service Commission to prepare and provide a future consolidation plan; this is planning and internal program development, with no dictated legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: provide me with a plan for combining the three existing programs into one

classifications.rationale: The President directs executive departments and agencies to support the Commission with cooperation, personnel, and assistance while expressly deferring any legally consequential executive order; this is internal coordination and resource assignment.
classifications.evidence: I am directing all Executive departments and agencies to cooperate fully with the Commission

classifications.rationale: The President advises departments and agencies to review their existing procedures against committee recommendations; this is an internal administrative review whose future results remain unspecified.
classifications.evidence: departments and agencies having employee security programs should reexamine their procedures
